initial_user_goal: Learn authentic artistic Chinese lettering construction decisions from finished professional work, transfer to unseen text with human blind aesthetic gain; existing Figma font tracing and width-only simulations unacceptable.

observations.publisher: Design for Asia Awards official Hanyi Redcloud Li showcase
visible: Black outlined hand-painted first-draft drawing at center
Dense black final rendered glyph at right
Two different examples arranged by rows
observations.derived_hypothesis: Creating contour layout and the ink/no-ink topology from style precedent occurs before finished texture; direct centerline thickening ignores this authored outline stage.
unsupported_claims: 1-to-1 path coordinates between gray original and final
Specific mathematical ratios transferable to other glyphs

observations.publisher: Typotheque / designer Zheng Chuyang first-person account
visible: Overlaid right-side 阝 radical contours show nonzero profile differences, especially bend/termination and proportion
observations.paired_article_explanation: Hundreds and thousands of character families need stage review; unusually wide recurring components amplify a visual imbalance, requiring family-level revision. The article explicitly discusses revising the proportion of 阝 in this illustration, and separately reducing a wide 口 component.
observations.derived_hypothesis: Family-level component visual corrections must be judged across multiple glyphs, not per-glyph threshold fit; whole outline & inter-component space remain design decisions.
unsupported_claims: All red-to-blue changes caused by a single scalar width
Source author used same specific distances in every glyph
The illustrator's sketch history or original controls reconstructed

observations.interpretation: Source bytes verified; not yet independently classified by a detailed same-glyph annotated visual read. Do not count as creator stroke process proof.
Source bytes verified; compressed counterpart may be a different finished font variant rather than an earlier revision, so no before/after claim.

next_experiment_rule.required: One independently observed same-glyph change family across at least two characters, with spatial changes annotated from true before/after images (not synthetic test fonts).
next_experiment_rule.prohibit: Don't create any synthetic ratio-morphing experiment based solely on images without explicit outcome evidence.
next_experiment_rule.evaluation: Compare frozen decision vs same-model/no-decision control on distinct unseen glyphs, force glyph correctness and user blind preference first; cannot claim learned creative approach before this.
next_experiment_rule.source_permissions: Third-party images only for observation/linked citation; no rehosting copyrighted pixels or training source assets without appropriate rights clearance.
